Dice the bacon, onion, celery and potatoes.Steam the clams open in a covered pot and strain the liquid.Render the bacon, add the onion and celery and cook until soft.Add the potatoes, clam liquid and milk and simmer.Stir in the cream and clams. Hollow out and toast the cob loaves and ladle the chowder in.Casper's big breakfastCasper cooks Kat a breakfast she can't possibly finishHow to make itAs written, serves 4Fluffy buttermilk pancakes, crisp bacon, soft scrambled eggs, golden hash browns and berries, all piled onto one huge plate with maple syrup.Whisk 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 375ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 40g melted butter and rest 15 minutes.Bake 8 hash browns at 220°C for 20 minutes.Fry 8 rashers bacon.Cook pancakes in butter 2 minutes a side.Whisk 6 eggs with a splash of cream and cook slowly in butter until just set.Pile onto 4 plates with 250g berries and maple syrup.SweetsMaine blueberry pieLattice topped blueberry pie, served with vanilla ice creamHow to make it750g blueberries150g caster sugar1 lemon3 tbsp cornflour4 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry1 L vanilla ice creamToss the blueberries with the sugar, lemon zest and cornflour.Line a pie dish with two pastry sheets, fill, and weave a lattice from the other two.Bake at 190°C.Cool before slicing.Serve with vanilla ice cream.Ghost meringuesCrisp piped meringue ghosts with chocolate chip eyesHow to make it3 eggs1 pinch cream of tartar180g caster sugar8 mini choc chipsWhisk the egg whites with the cream of tartar, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until stiff and glossy.Pipe tall teardrop ghosts and press in choc chips for eyes.Bake at 100°C.Cool in the oven with the door closed.DrinksWhipstaff cream soda floatsVanilla ice cream with cream soda poured over, served with long spoonsHow to make it8 scoops of vanilla ice cream1.3 L cream sodaPut two scoops of ice cream in each of four tall glasses.Pour cold cream soda over slowly so it foams up the sides.
